target.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intNegOnePowParityResidualV1
target.statement_role: derive powFn (n + 1) as the parity-indexed sign without naming the concrete power implementation

power: powSucc : forall n, powFn (n + 1) = powFn n * (-1)
parity: modCases : forall n, n % 2 = 0 or n % 2 = 1

method: induct on n; rewrite the previous sign through powSucc, use only the explicit multiplication leaf for that sign, and use succOne or succZero to normalize the next conditional
next_on_accept: compose the residual with the existing four clean parity roots and a separately qualified concrete Int power/algebra capsule
limitations: A parameterized residual is not the concrete (-1 : Int) power theorem and grants no exact-target or ledger authority.
